tools.name: who_am_i
tools.readOnlyJustification: Diagnostic tool - only resolves the connected Square merchant/locations via SquareContextResolver. Makes no Square write calls.
tools.openWorldJustification: Depends on live data from the Square API, an external system outside the MCP server's own closed dataset.
tools.destructiveJustification: No data is created, modified, or removed - it only reports current connection state.

tools.name: square_connect_account
tools.readOnlyJustification: Either reads the existing Square connection state or returns a signed one-time link string; the tool call itself performs no Square or business-data writes.
tools.openWorldJustification: Reflects live Square merchant-connection state from an external system.
tools.destructiveJustification: No data is changed or removed. The actual account-linking write happens later, out-of-band, via the user's browser OAuth flow, not this tool call.

tools.name: search_scheduled_shifts
tools.readOnlyJustification: Lists scheduled shifts via ScheduledShiftService.searchForPeriod only - explicitly documented as read-only.
tools.openWorldJustification: Queries live schedule data from the external Square API.

tools.name: get_schedule_constraints
tools.readOnlyJustification: Reads workweek configuration and scheduled hours only; documented as 'Read-only overtime-risk inputs'.
tools.openWorldJustification: Pulls live workweek and scheduling data from the external Square API.

tools.name: get_timecard_exceptions
tools.readOnlyJustification: Description states 'Read-only - never auto-corrects'; only searches and analyzes existing timecards.
tools.openWorldJustification: Reads live Square timecard data from an external system.
tools.destructiveJustification: Detects issues but never modifies the underlying timecards.

tools.name: prepare_payroll_reconciliation
tools.readOnlyJustification: Explicitly a 'Read-only payroll prep summary... Does not submit or finalize payroll'.
tools.openWorldJustification: Summarizes live Square timecard state from an external system.
tools.destructiveJustification: Read-only aggregation with no side effects.

tools.name: reconcile_cash_tips
tools.readOnlyJustification: 'Preview only - makes no changes in Square'; only computes an allocation and signs a previewToken, with no Square write calls.
tools.openWorldJustification: Reads live closed timecards from the external Square API to compute the proposed split.
tools.destructiveJustification: Nothing is committed; the write only happens later in commit_cash_tips after explicit owner approval.

tools.name: create_draft_schedule
tools.readOnlyJustification: Calls client.labor.createScheduledShift, a Square write operation.
tools.openWorldJustification: Creates data in the external Square system.
tools.destructiveJustification: Only adds new draft shifts not yet visible to staff; it never overwrites or removes existing shifts, and overlap/authorization checks are enforced first.

tools.name: publish_schedule
tools.readOnlyJustification: Calls client.labor.bulkPublishScheduledShifts, a Square write operation; description calls it 'the consequential step in scheduling'.
tools.openWorldJustification: Changes state in the external Square system and triggers staff notifications.
tools.destructiveJustification: Transitions already-created draft shifts to published (a status/visibility change) without deleting or irreversibly overwriting shift data; requires explicit shift IDs and an approved_by value.

tools.name: update_draft_shift
tools.readOnlyJustification: Calls client.labor.updateScheduledShift, a Square write operation.
tools.openWorldJustification: Mutates draft shift data in the external Square system.
tools.destructiveJustification: Can update or delete (via is_deleted) a draft shift; passing is_deleted true removes the draft outright, and other fields overwrite prior values, causing potential data loss.

tools.name: commit_cash_tips
tools.readOnlyJustification: Calls client.labor.updateTimecard to write the declared cash-tip amount back onto Square timecards.
tools.openWorldJustification: Writes to live payroll data in the external Square system.
tools.destructiveJustification: Overwrites each timecard's declaredCashTipMoney, an irreversible payroll change - gated behind a signed, time-limited preview_token and an approved_by value.

tools.name: get_location_sales_intelligence
tools.readOnlyJustification: Searches completed Square Orders and computes an in-memory response for the current tool call only.
tools.openWorldJustification: Depends on live sales data in the external Square Orders API.
tools.destructiveJustification: Does not create, update, or delete orders or merchant data.

tools.name: compare_location_sales
tools.readOnlyJustification: Searches completed Square Orders for authorized locations and only aggregates the returned data.
tools.openWorldJustification: Depends on live external Square Orders data.
tools.destructiveJustification: Makes no changes to any Square record.

tools.name: get_catalog_readiness
tools.readOnlyJustification: Only calls Square Catalog Search and reports catalog-health gaps.
tools.openWorldJustification: Queries the merchant's live Square catalog.
tools.destructiveJustification: Does not create, update, archive, or delete catalog objects.

tools.name: get_inventory_stock_status
tools.readOnlyJustification: Uses Square Catalog's stock-level query filter to report LOW and OUT items only.
tools.openWorldJustification: Reads live Square catalog and inventory classification data.
tools.destructiveJustification: Does not adjust counts or make any inventory change.

tools.name: get_labor_vs_sales
tools.readOnlyJustification: Searches existing Square timecards and completed orders, then computes an in-memory operational estimate.
tools.openWorldJustification: Depends on live external Square Labor and Orders data.
tools.destructiveJustification: Does not alter timecards, orders, payroll, or any other Square data.

tools.name: get_workforce_coverage
tools.readOnlyJustification: Searches scheduled shifts and lists Square jobs to summarize existing coverage.
tools.openWorldJustification: Uses live external Square Labor and Team API data.
tools.destructiveJustification: Does not change shifts, jobs, or team members.
